thread:
Ari Jacobson: Quick async check-in on SOC2/ISO workstreams — can folks call out current owners, blockers, and any cross-team deps? timeline goal: milestone checkpoint by next Wed (2026-03-25).
Priya Patel: Owner for KMS/HSM integration here. HSM PoC finished last week. Waiting on vendor FIPS certs and HSM access in prod subnet. Blocker: cloud infra needs to open HSM mgmt ports and approve egress rules.
Marco Liu: I can take the infra changes. PR up for the subnet + route: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/infra/pulls/432 — needs review from eng-infra. Also need to coordinate with network for scheduled maintenance window.
Evelyn Cho: From compliance: audit evidence owners? We need mapping for these controls: CC6/CC7 (key mgmt) and AU-2 (audit logging). Who will own evidence collection for the KMS/HSM rollout?
Priya Patel: I can own evidence for key lifecycle (creation, rotation, destruction). Need Samir to lead audit log retention mapping.
Samir Anand: Will take audit logs. Quick question: what retention window are we standardizing on for SOC2? Current suggestion is 1 year for primary logs and 3 years archived.
Evelyn Cho: 1yr primary + 3yr archive sounds fine for SOC2. For ISO, we might need 6 months of more granular SIEM indices — will confirm. Need log export to customer SIEM (for Dedicated) as a dependency.
Marco Liu: On export — infra can stream to S3 then to SIEM. Need a schema for logs. Priya, can you share required log fields for key events?
Priya Patel: Minimal key events: key.create, key.rotate, key.disable, key.delete, key.use (with key-id, principal, timestamp, operation, request_id). Example config for local dev: 
```
# dev config
audit.log.retention_days = 365
audit.destination = "s3://redwood-audit-prod/keys"
kms.rotate.schedule = "cron(0 3 * * 1)"
```
Marco Liu: Thanks. I'll add transformation to include request_id. PR #432 updated with transformer.
Ari Jacobson: Thread note — we also need to surface when HSM vendor certs land. @sec-bot can you add a follow-up reminder if certs not received by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 1745158400 (2026-03-20T17:00:00Z) for "HSM vendor certs follow-up".
Samir Anand: On evidence, I'll start a checklist in the compliance doc and tag owners. Link: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/SOC2/SOC2+2026+Checklist (WIP). I'll add estimated artifacts and owner for each control.
Evelyn Cho: Can someone confirm PR reviewers for infra? We need at least eng-infra + eng-security approval before merge. Marco, please add required reviewers in the PR.
Marco Liu: Done. Added reviewers: @eng-infra, @eng-security, and @platform. Also set merge freeze until approvals.
Priya Patel: One more blocker: key material export controls — we need KMS to prevent key export from HSM. Vendor says default prevents export, but we need test evidence. Plan: run key-migration test in staging and capture logs.
Ari Jacobson: Action items summary (please react with ✅ when done):
- Priya: test key export proof & own key lifecycle evidence ✅?
- Marco: infra PR + open HSM ports — add merge reviewers ✅?
- Samir: audit log retention mapping + create evidence checklist ✅?
- Evelyn: confirm ISO logging granularity & sign-off on retention ✅?
- sec-bot: reminder for vendor certs Friday ✅?
Priya Patel: I'll post test results in this thread and attach the logs. Expected by Tue EOD.
Marco Liu: I'll ping network ops for port approval now.
Evelyn Cho: I'll confirm ISO details and update the confluence page by Tue morning.
Samir Anand: Checklist created and initial items assigned. Putting PR links and sample logs in the doc now.
Ari Jacobson: Thanks team. Quick ping — @Priya Patel @Marco Liu please add short review notes on PR #432 so I can preview for PM.
Priya Patel: Reviewing tonight.
Marco Liu: Left a couple of inline comments.
Priya Patel: Verified key.rotate event includes request_id in staging logs. attaching snippet.
Samir Anand: Nice. I'll include that as evidence for AU-2.
Evelyn Cho: :tada: Good progress.
sec-bot: Automated: New compliance task created: "Collect key lifecycle logs" assigned to Priya Patel, due 1745097600.
Ari Jacobson: Closing loop — follow-ups in the confluence checklist. Will re-check end of day Friday. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
Priya Patel: ✅
Marco Liu: ✅
Samir Anand: ✅
Evelyn Cho: ✅
